title: Nea Ɔkyekyee Akwanside ahorow
intro: Wɔ nsase akɛse so no, ankorankoro bi a ɔwɔ tumi fii akwantu ahorow ase, na wɔmaa no tumi ne ahonyade kɛse. Saa ɔkra yi hyiaa mpɔtam ahorow na ohyiaa nsɛnnennen soronko, gyaw agyiraehyɛde a ɛtra hɔ daa wɔ abakɔsɛm ne gyidi so denam wɔn nneyɛe ne nyansa so, bere a ne nyinaa gyee wɔn ahoɔden fibea ankasa toom no.
clues: Wɔmaa me tumi ne ɔkwan a mɛfa so wɔ biribiara so, na midii ɔkwan bi akyi.
M’akwantu no de me kɔɔ baabi a owia rekɔtɔ, baabi a mihuu nnipa bi.
Mihyiaa mpɔtam bi a ɛkame ayɛ sɛ wontumi nte kasa ase, na wɔte mmepɔw abien ntam.
Wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ mensi akwanside, ɛnyɛ m’ankasa mfaso, na mmom mfa mmɔ me ho ban mfi tumi bi a ɛsɛe ade ho.
Mepaee mu kae se ahoɔden a wɔde besi ɔfasu kɛseɛ yi firi Allah hɔ, na ɛbɛgyina akosi berɛ a wɔahyɛ ho bɔ.
Me din a wɔtaa kyerɛ ase sɛ ‘Nea Ɔwɔ Mbɛn Abien’ no kyerɛ sɛnea matumi akɔ asase so anaa ebia mmere abien a ɛsono emu biara.

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Nkwagye a wonya fi nsuyiri mu

arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
